anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Stephen De Young" time="0:0:0">He will be a staff for the righteous with which for them to stand and not to fall, and he will be the light of the nations and the hope of those whose hearts are troubled. All who dwell on the Earth will fall down and worship him, and they will praise and bless and celebrate with song, the Lord of spirits. First [[Enoch]] chapter 48, verses 4 through 5.</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:23:35">Um, yeah, and then another thing that was celebrated, uh, uh, another sort of aspect that was sometimes celebrated that has some interesting biblical, uh, echoes was the marriage of the god to the city as his bride. Um, so the the that bond we were just talking about, like the one that the Athenians saw in Athens, right? They would talk about this in terms of, you know, Hephaestus having Athens as a bride, right? And and the goddess Athena being sort of a personification as feminine of the city itself. Right.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Caller" time="02:20:31">Uh yeah. Uh glad that I was on this a little bit of something there.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="08:12:43">Thank you very much and [[God]] bless you and happy feast of the [[Ascension]].</Dialogue>
